reason: The 2024-11-06 What's New item (effective 2024-10-25) is the newest statement on this; the later change items (flat-rate plan API, OAC for MRAP, DIT, cache-tag invalidation and others) do not touch it, and corpus search for 'blocked by AWS WAF' finds only consistent statements (flat-rate plan pages and FAQ say blocked requests never count against the allowance). The rev-3 claim keeps the scope to CloudFront charges and excludes AWS WAF's own charges.
